game_concept: A action puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar, an altar half-sunk in earth: the scholar mage must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Stat Market: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar: an altar half-sunk in earth
core_gameplay_loop: In Sunken Altar, repeat each round: Use min(), max(), and sum() over a price list to make profitable trades. Each round, a new relic shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of relic shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Stat Market
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stat Market' (Week 7 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sunken Altar'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Sunken Altar.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 48 seconds.
